company_name: Automated Tooling Systems India Pvt. Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company primarily focuses on industrial automation and engineering services rather than semiconductor-specific products.
summary: Automated Tooling Systems India Pvt. Ltd specializes in industrial automation and engineering services, including the design and manufacture of special purpose machines (SPMs) and assembly line automation solutions. Their capabilities extend to providing turnkey automation solutions for various industries, but they do not specifically cater to the semiconductor sector.

regional_presence.India: The company operates in India, providing automation solutions and engineering services to global clients.
